decisions.reason: The request for help placing the manufacturer order does not change any component sourceability, availability, or cost-selection policy.
Ordering assistance may use the BOM, but the source does not change the BOM's contents, accuracy, or assembly-readiness requirements.
The source establishes assistance with ordering and says nothing about KiCad project portability or footprint resolution.
Manufacturer ordering assistance does not alter the current-monitoring IC, measured rails, channels, or measurement topology.
The source does not change any interboard connector, pinout, or board power-distribution requirement.
The general promise of ordering assistance does not resolve or modify the LED board's role, LED count, or unresolved LED-part selection.
The source does not change the sensor board's connector inventory, pinouts, or module interfaces.
Ordering assistance does not alter the LED supply voltage, level-shifter requirement, or selected level-shifter part.
The source contains no change to the AXP2101 USB, battery, VMID, or VSYS power-path behavior.
The ordering-assistance decision does not modify the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance requirements.
The source does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or any module-breakout requirement.
The source does not change any GPIO assignment, availability constraint, or compatibility policy.
